item.title: Vacaville Police identify shooting victim
item.description: A 24-year-old man who died Monday after a shooting in a Vacaville apartment was identified Tuesday by police, though no information on any potential suspects has been released. “The victim in yesterday’s shooting has been identified as Davion Calvin, 24, of Vacaville,” police said in an updated news release issued Tuesday morning. item.title: Athlete of the Week: Bethel’s Nathan Hoang makes the cut for TCAL title
item.description: After receiving a first-round bye, the senior picked up an 18-1 technical fall in the semifinals and cruised to an 11-4 victory in the first-place match, marking his second straight league championship at 115 pounds.
